title: Software Engineer I (New Grad)
description:
About the role
Join our routing platform team building the services that schedule 40,000 deliveries a day.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain backend services and internal tools
- Write tests and participate in code review
- Work with product and operations to ship features

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
- Proficiency in Java or Python
- Working knowledge of SQL
- Experience with Git
- 0-2 years of experience; new graduates welcome

Nice to have
- Spring Boot
- AWS
- Docker

title: Associate Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Prairie Health Tech builds scheduling software for community clinics.

Responsibilities
- Build patient-facing features across our React frontend and Node.js API
- Design and consume REST APIs
- Collaborate with designers on accessible UI

Qualifications
- 1+ years of professional software development experience
- Strong TypeScript and React skills
- Experience building REST APIs
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

Preferred
- Next.js
- GraphQL
- Familiarity with healthcare data and HIPAA

title: Backend Engineer
description:
We build fleet software for warehouse robots.

You will
- Design services that coordinate hundreds of robots in real time
- Own reliability of our message pipeline

Minimum qualifications
- 2+ years of backend development in Go or Rust
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes
- Experience designing distributed systems
- BS in Computer Science or equivalent

Bonus points
- gRPC
- Kafka
- PostgreSQL

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Riverline's research platform team puts models into production for our trading desks.

Requirements
- MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field
- 3+ years deploying machine learning models to production
- Deep experience with PyTorch
- Strong Python
- Experience with large-scale data processing (Spark or similar)

Nice to have
- LLM fine-tuning
- MLOps tooling such as MLflow

title: Senior Software Engineer, Embedded C++
description:
Develop flight software for airborne sensor systems.

Required
- 7+ years of C++ development on embedded systems
- Active TS/SCI security clearance required at start date
- U.S. citizenship
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering

Desired
- Real-time operating systems (VxWorks or similar)
- DO-178C experience
